text: Drill Operators are goblins located in Slam Central Station in Undermine.
Drowned Pillagers are skeletal vrykul located in the Forbidden Reach.
Dressed to the Mines is a collections achievements earned by an armor set from the Liberation of Undermine.
Drill Sergeant is an extractor located in the Sidestreet Sluice delve.

Dril Sparkshot is a goblin located in Bilgewater Flats in the Undermine. Dril provides a shortcut to the top area of the Bilgewater building, the Exotics Market, and the Scrapshot Shot skyrocketing race area.
The Drenched Cavern is a cave located in south Nazmir. It is behind a waterfall between the two central bridges from Zuldazar into Nazmir. A Lost Spawn of Krag'wa is found inside.
Dripping Shadow is a void revenant located in Parhelion Plaza on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host. It is surrounded by several Oozing Voids.
__NOTOC__ Drifter Jellies are looted from Delectable Root Drifters in Nai'theren Grotto in Harandar.
A Dropped Sword can be found next to Thel Bloodmee at Lightbloom Ath'Ran in Eversong Woods. Interacting with it will cut Thel free from the vines entangling him.
Drill Mechanic is a goblin located in Slam Central Station in Undermine. He can be seen putting a sign "OUT OF ORDER - Vibes Were Off".
Drolkrad is the tauralus mount of Sabriel the Bonecleaver at the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus. It will fight alongside her.
Dripping Barrels are found in the Ember Court during the Ride on the Wild Side event as food for the Hungry Gorm.

Drifting Aurelids are aurelids found inside the waters of central Zereth Mortis. During Fish Eyes, they can be pulled to the surface using a Fishing Portal. This will turn them into regular Aurelids that can be fought.
Drifting Conch Whistle can be pickpocketed from Darkspine naga and Tideborne smugglers.

Drowning Foals are small vorquin found at the Apex Canopy on the Waking Shores during Grand Hunts. They need to be saved by carrying them back to land.
Dropped Key is looted from the object of the same name dropped by Nacretta on the Coiled Isle after giving her a Luminescent Pearl (Coiled Isle). It is used to unlock Brine-Crusted Chest.

The Durotar Supply and Logistics is the Horde's robust supply network that fuels its rapid expansion across Kalimdor and beyond. The Alliance version of this faction is Azeroth Commerce Authority.
Durotar Pig Meat drops from the following boars in : *Corrupted Mottled Boar *Dire Mottled Boar *Elder Mottled Boar The meat can be used to lure out Raluk at the center of the northern Echo Isles.
Durable Plate of the Golden Lotus is a death knight and warrior quest reward from Battle Axe of the Thunder King (quest).
Dun Morogh Pig Meat drops from boars in . The meat can be used to lure out Jorul at the bear cave east of Iceflow Lake.

The Dun Morogh Treasure Map is created by combining the Top-Right Map Piece, Top-Left Map Piece, Bottom-Right Map Piece, and Bottom-Left Map Piece found in . Use it beneath the bridge between Kharanos and Ironforge at to find the Rune of Quick Draw.

The Durotar Treasure Map is created by combining the Top-Right Map Piece, Top-Left Map Piece, Bottom-Right Map Piece, and Bottom-Left Map Piece found in . Use it near the monkey head on the southernmost of the Echo Isles at to find the Rune of Quick Draw.
Durgaz Cabin is a small outpost in the Ironwold on the eastern part of the Isle of Dorn.
Durakh is an earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.

Dunelle's Kindness is a town with a dawntower, located in the eastern extent of the zone. Players are directed here in the first quest of the Hallowfall storyline, The Hallowed Path. The town is bordered by Lothar's Landing to the east, Shadowmire to the southeast, The Aegis Wall to the south, Rumshackle to the west, and Growling Hollow to the north. The Dunelle's Detour skyriding race is started northeast of town.
Duke Searbrand is a fire elemental found in the Slag Pit in the during the Blackrock Eruption event.
Duke's Domain is sold by Duke Hydraxis in for upon reaching with the Hydraxian Waterlords.

Durgo the Vast is a hobgoblin located in the Hovel Hill in the Undermine.
Durable Dice is looted from the Blackened Dice in the Vatworks in Undermine. It can also be bought from Paks Topskimmer for .

Durable Information Securing Container is a quest reward from Durable Information Storage Container, part of the Overcharged Delves questline. There are four versions of this item, one for each armor type. The item level starts at 691 (Champion 4 in Season 3) and increases up to 701 (Hero 3) via the Titan Memory Card rewarded from the weekly Gathering an Upgrade quest from Dagran Thaurissan II at Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal.
Duos Underdog is a Dastardly Duos achievement tasking players with dying three times during a match, then coming back from behind to win!

Duo Darling is a Dastardly Duos achievement tasking players with first earning Duos Underdog by dying three times during a match and still coming out on top, then checking in with Vinnie Sweets back at camp.

]] Durable Information Storage Container concludes the Overcharged Delves questline in week one, awarding the Durable Information Securing Container customizable belt. Start by speaking with Dagran Thaurissan II at Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal or an Overcharged Titan Console in a delve to begin. In future weeks, players will be able to upgrade the belt's item level by completing Dagran's followup quests.
Dull Javelin can drop from a Hellcaller Chest during the A Greedy Emissary event.

Durnholde Lookouts were humans who were found at Durnholde Keep in Old Hillsbrad Foothills on heroic mode. They patrolled with Durnholde Tracking Hounds that could see through stealth. Upon aggroing them, they would summon two Durnholde Reinforcements.
Durnholde Reinforcements were humans who would be summoned upon aggroing Durnholde Lookouts at Durnholde Keep in Old Hillsbrad Foothills on heroic mode.
Dumpsterdelver's Loop drops from The Underpin in Demolition Dome.
Duelist Xaheen is an ethereal located in North Sufaad on K'aresh.
Dune Wyrms are mana wyrms located near the Oasis on K'aresh.

Dungeoneer's Training Dummies are the training dummies located throughout Azeroth and beyond. Their titles mark exactly what spec they are used for: Tanking, Damage, Cleave, and Healing. Cleave may be the odd one out, but there are usually three dummies close together that allow one to test out an AoE build.
Duplicate Documents are given to the adventurer by Magister Dawnblaze upon accepting Stir the Nest.

Durotar Frostblade is an ally card from the War of the Ancients set.

Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft (also shortened as D&D: World of Warcraft) is the third edition core rule book for the Warcraft RPG.
Dungeon Master's Screen is a sourcebook for Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft.

Dundun's Favor is a curio for Valeera Sanguinar during Midnight Season 2. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves. Rank 5 can be obtained from the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan after reaching rank 1 in Kindo'jan's Labyrinth Journey.
Dulvar, Hand of the Light is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Durgen Dirgehammer is the fourth and last boss in the Hall of Thanes instance, found at the Reliquary of Kings. He is accompanied by two Lesser Stone Golems.

Dusky Timbertooths are timbertooths occasionally found inside a Beaver Dam north of Forkriver Crossing in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Clearing the dam will cause the timbertooth to jump out and become battleable.
Durumu's Glass Pupil drops from Durumu the Forgotten. It is needed to obtain the Grimoire of the Ancient Observer.
Duskblaze Shadowstalkers are satyr located near the Dream portal in the Twilight Grove in .
Durus is an infinite dragonspawn vendor located at Infinite Bazaars during the WoW Remix events.

Duskrise Acreage is the southwestern extent of the greater Light's Blooming farmland in northeastern Hallowfall. On the farm, the fields are bordered by the Hillhelm Stead to the northwest, the Light's Blooming dawntower to the north, and Fungal Fields to the east.
Duskshadow is a mistlurker located at Torchlight Mine in Hallowfall.
Dust-Covered Cloak is a quest reward from A Gem-Splitting Headache.

Dusk's Repose is an inn located at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm. It consists of a single circular room with a void orb in the center and various doodads around the edges: crates and barrels, a weapon rack, some bedrolls, and a table with an Unpublished Manuscript on it. A mailbox can be found just outside.

Eadweard Dalyngrigge is the lead archivist of the Azerothian Archives and an archbishop emeritus. He is located at the Azerothian Archives office in Thaldraszus and Traitor's Rest in the Azure Span. He runs the :The Big Dig: Traitor's Rest public scenario every hour at the bottom of the hour. After Fyrakk's defeat in Amirdrassil, an adventurer looking to wield his weapon, Fyr'alath the Dreamrender, sought Eadweard for his knowledge on shadowflame and ancient artifacts. Eadweard instructed the adventurer on how to modify the haft of the weapon so that the shadowflame within it could be contained and directed him to crafters who could help with the task. Opening it requires five shard items looted from Loose Crystal Shards across the Ringing Deeps: Rough Deepamethyst Shard, Rough Deepdiamond Shard, Rough Deepemerald Shard, Rough Deepruby Shard, and Rough Deeptopaz Shard.
Dusty Urns are located in Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest during the draenei heritage questline. They are tended to by Auchenai Soulpriests.
Dwarven Historians are Wildhammer dwares found interviewing Alforila in the Library in Ironforge.
EZ-Mine Bismuth can be found in Khaz Algar. Approaching them blasts with EZ-Mine Dynamites.

Eaglewatch Outpost is an area located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Dwarven Sharpshooters are dwarves located in Sanguine Grasps in Hallowfall. They are fighting against Xal'atath's Kaheti nerubians during the defense of the Aegis Wall.
Dwarf Paladins are projections that appear during Story Time in Tanaris. They fight the enemies in The Heroes of the Scarab Wall.
The Dynamite-Laden Coil is located in the Liberation of Undermine.

The Dusty Stone Tablet is looted from the Archeology Chest in Things of the Past in Dalaran during the Legion Remix intro quests. Momentus is looking for it in Thrift.
Dusty Timepieces are sand elementals located Sand-Lost Sanctum in Thaldraszus.

The Dye Station is a crafting station located in the Town Center in Founder's Point and the Common in Razorwind Shores.
